📍 Angel Falls, Venezuela 🇻🇪

The world’s tallest uninterrupted waterfall plunges 979m from a tabletop mountain in Canaima National Park.

Its water can turn to mist before reaching the ground below.

Would you journey into this remote wilderness?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Venezuela #AngelFalls

📍 Ilhéu de Vila Franca do Campo, Azores, Portugal 🇵🇹

This volcanic islet hides a nearly circular lagoon connected to the Atlantic by a narrow opening.

Its turquoise waters make it a unique spot for swimming and snorkeling. Would you visit?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Azores #Portugal

📍 Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Abu Dhabi 🇦🇪

White marble domes, reflective pools and intricate floral designs make this landmark unforgettable.

It features 82 domes and one of the world’s largest hand-knotted carpets. 

Would you visit?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #AbuDhabi #UAE

📍 Cliffs of Moher, County Clare, Ireland 🇮🇪

Towering up to 214m above the Atlantic, these dramatic cliffs stretch for 8km along Ireland’s west coast.

Seabirds circle overhead as waves crash far below.

Would you walk along the edge?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Ireland #CliffsOfMoher

📍 Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia 🇲🇾

The iconic Petronas Twin Towers rise 452m above the city, linked by a skybridge between floors 41 and 42.

Their gleaming steel façades dominate the skyline.

Would you visit the observation deck?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #KualaLumpur #Malaysia
